`final class NodeProgressEvent<N extends Node>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`NodeEvent<N>`](/reference/events/nodeevent/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event.impl.node` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [NodeProgressEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/impl/node/NodeProgressEvent.java)

The event of `onProgress` on a resource player, with the progress of the playback.

## Description

[`ResourcePlayerNode`](/reference/nodes/resourceplayernode/) fires it on the frames where the progress of its playback changed.

- [Images and media](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/media/)
